tool_schemas.name: get_n8n_info
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the current n8n Assistant deployment metadata and computed status for the requested deployment, optionally filtering by environment, and can include related n8n instances and/or capabilities; when instances are included, set primary_instance_only to return only the instance marked is_primary. Returns a single deployment info object (not paged) with the included related records embedded when requested. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter values (including unsupported environment/include values), NOT_FOUND if no matching deployment exists for the given deployment_id/environment filter, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view deployment details.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id to retrieve info for (ULID like n8na_dep_01H...).

environment.description: Filter to the deployment for a specific environment.

include.description: Which related records to include alongside deployment info.

primary_instance_only.description: If true, only include the primary n8n instance (is_primary=true) when including instances.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Lists deployments visible to the caller, optionally filtered by environment and status, ordered by updated_at desc. Returns a paginated list; refuses invalid filters.

environment.description: Only return deployments for the given environment.

status.description: Only return deployments with the given lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of deployments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: get_deployment
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single deployment by id. Returns the deployment record; refuses if the id is not found or not accessible.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id to fetch (ULID like n8na_dep_01H...).

include.description: Optionally embed related n8n instances and/or service capabilities.

primary_instance_only.description: If true and instances are included, only return the instance marked is_primary=true (most recently updated if multiple exist).

tool_schemas.name: update_deployment
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable deployment fields and/or advances its lifecycle status. Returns the updated deployment; refuses invalid lifecycle transitions or invalid field values.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id to update (ULID like n8na_dep_01H...).

public_name.description: Public display name for the deployment.

repository_url.description: Repository URL for the deployment source.

service_base_url.description: Base URL where the assistant service is reachable for this deployment.

git_commit.description: Git commit hash or identifier for the build.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the deployment; must follow allowed transitions.

tool_schemas.name: list_n8n_instances
tool_schemas.description: Lists n8n instances, optionally filtered by deployment, status, and primary flag, ordered by updated_at desc. Returns a paginated list; refuses invalid filters.

deployment_id.description: Only return instances belonging to this deployment id.

status.description: Only return instances with the given lifecycle status.

is_primary.description: If set, filters instances by whether they are marked primary.

limit.description: Maximum number of instances to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: update_n8n_instance
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable n8n instance fields and/or advances its lifecycle status. Returns the updated instance; refuses invalid lifecycle transitions, or attempts to violate the single-primary-per-deployment rule.

instance_id.description: n8n instance id to update (ULID like n8na_ins_01H...).

base_url.description: Base URL for the n8n instance.

n8n_version.description: Detected or configured n8n version string.

auth_type.description: How the assistant should authenticate when describing this instance.

is_primary.description: Whether this instance is the primary instance for its deployment.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the instance; must follow allowed transitions.

metadata.name: n8n Assistant
metadata.description: This backend stores metadata about an n8n Assistant deployment and the n8n instance(s) it can describe. The primary workflow is read-only: clients call get_n8n_info to retrieve the current deployment/instance information, versioning, and health/status details; operators can update the stored config/
